description: Source code for a video decoder class using the libde265 library, implementing decoding of H.265 video streams with support for decode-to-texture and decode-to-buffer modes.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing H.265 video decoding using libde265, supporting decode to buffer or texture modes.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with specified codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears queued frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the libde265 decoder context and worker threads.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::TeardownCodec
methods.description: Cleans up the decoder context and releases decode targets.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Processes a single input buffer, pushing data into the decoder.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Flushes the decoder to process remaining frames at stream end.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Decodes available frames, creates video frames, and manages callbacks.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
